translation: Tom hurried back into the house.

text: Quid Thomas ita festinat?
translation: Why is Tom in such a hurry?

text: Ad stationem ferriviariam festinavit.
translation: We hurried to the train station.

text: Quae Deus immittit non vincunt frigora vestem.
translation: God tempers the wind to the shorn lamb.

text: Thomas ob frigora summa fere mortuus est.
translation: Tom almost froze to death.

text: Heri mane valde frigus erat.
translation: It was very cold yesterday morning.

text: Num frigus noctis est gratum?
translation: The cold of the night isn’t very pleasant, is it?

translation: Don't forget your gloves. It's cold.

text: Hodie valde frigus est.
translation: It is very cold today.

text: Estne aliquid de indice ciborum tibi rogandum?

text: Thomas et nomen suum et Mariae in indicem rettulit.
translation: Tom added both his and Mary's name to the list.

translation: From the words on this list, how many can you understand?

translation: Tom's name has been added to the list.

translation: Tom added Mary's name to the list.

text: Lingua Anglica mihi magis quam mathematica placet.

translation: I don't want to go outside this afternoon.

text: Multiplica per numerum negativum incertum.
translation: Multiply it by a random negative number.

text: Vos autem crescite et multiplicamini et pullulate super terram et dominamini ei.
translation: But increase you and multiply, and go upon the earth and fill it.

translation: And I will make my covenant between me and thee: and I will multiply thee exceedingly.

translation: And God blessed Noah and his sons. And he said to them: Increase, and multiply, and fill the earth.

text: Multae nubes in caelo sunt quod tempestas venit.
translation: There are many clouds in the sky because the storm is coming.

text: Sine lexico probo, nihil facere potes.

translation: I love red parrots.
